pages.text: Use a Dark Nether Star on the frame to consume the star and activate a Runic Tenebris Core.$(br2)The core converts Runes into Dark Runes.

pages.title: No Spawning
pages.text: Use one Arcane Crystal on Runic Chiseled Polished Darkstone to activate it. It prevents monster spawning within a 25-block spherical radius.
